# ZizkaDB

> ZizkaDB is an open-source database built for AI agents. It records every agent action as an event linked to the event that caused it, so you can see why an agent made a decision (`why`), what it knew at any past moment (`at`), and prove the history was not changed (per-agent hash chain). It is the source of truth for what an agent actually did, independent of the LLM. AGPL-3.0 (the MCP server is MIT). Runs on Postgres with Docker.

Key facts:
- Install: `pip install zizkadb-sdk` (Python) or `npm install zizkadb-sdk` (TypeScript), version 0.5. Import: `from zizkadb import ZizkaDB`.
- Run locally: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZIZKA-AI-SL/ZizkaDB/main/scripts/quickstart-remote.sh | bash` starts one container (Postgres, API, dashboard) and logs a demo agent run. API on http://localhost:8000, dashboard on http://localhost:3001. The full stack (`infra/docker-compose.yml`) adds Redis and Qdrant.
- Core calls: `log()` records an event (`parent_id` links cause and effect), `why(event_id)` walks the causal chain, `at(agent, timestamp)` replays past state, `search()` finds past events (keyword, semantic or hybrid), `context_for(agent, task)` returns ranked memory for the next prompt, `verify_chain(agent)` checks the hash chain.
- Integrity: checksum per event, per-agent hash chain, tombstones for deletions, secret redaction before storage.
- Database features: idempotent and batch writes, cursor paging, retention, NDJSON export/import, read-only and expiring API keys, Prometheus metrics, backup and restore scripts.
- Works without OpenAI: keyword search is built in; embeddings are optional (local, OpenAI or your own key).
- Integrations: LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, LiveKit voice agents, MCP (Claude, Cursor), REST API.
- Self-hosted (this repo, free): one agent with one API key; data stays on your servers.
- ZizkaDB Cloud (https://db.zizka.ai, paid): multiple agents, agent fleets and agent-to-agent message recording.
- Made by Zizka AI (https://zizka.ai).

## Packages
- [Python SDK `zizkadb-sdk`](https://pypi.org/project/zizkadb-sdk/) (source: [sdk/python](https://github.com/ZIZKA-AI-SL/ZizkaDB/tree/main/sdk/python))
- [TypeScript SDK `zizkadb-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/zizkadb-sdk) (source: [sdk/typescript](https://github.com/ZIZKA-AI-SL/ZizkaDB/tree/main/sdk/typescript))
- [MCP server `zizkadb-mcp`](https://pypi.org/project/zizkadb-mcp/): `uvx zizkadb-mcp` (source: [mcp](https://github.com/ZIZKA-AI-SL/ZizkaDB/tree/main/mcp))
- Integrations: [`zizkadb-langchain`](https://pypi.org/project/zizkadb-langchain/), [`zizkadb-crewai`](https://pypi.org/project/zizkadb-crewai/), [`zizkadb-langgraph`](https://pypi.org/project/zizkadb-langgraph/), [`zizkadb-livekit`](https://pypi.org/project/zizkadb-livekit/) (source: [integrations](https://github.com/ZIZKA-AI-SL/ZizkaDB/tree/main/integrations))

## Example

```python
from zizkadb import ZizkaDB

async with ZizkaDB(host="http://localhost:8000") as db:
    user = await db.log(agent="support-bot", event="user_message", data={"text": "Refund order 42"})
    tool = await db.log(agent="support-bot", event="tool_call", data={"tool": "refund"}, parent_id=user.event_id)
    chain = await db.why(tool.event_id)           # the decision path back to the user message
    state = await db.at("support-bot", some_time)  # what the agent knew then
    check = await db.verify_chain("support-bot")   # was the history changed?
```
